summary: The candidate gates forwarded scheme, host, and address metadata on adapter-authenticated contexts or loopback proxy peers, sanitizes direct requests, keys abuse controls from prepared metadata, and adds coverage for forged headers and proxy chains.

evidence: src/request_origin.ts:53-84 strips forwarding headers for untrusted peers and records only adapter-authenticated client metadata.
src/request_origin.ts:93-114 only honors forwarded scheme and host when the request has trusted proxy metadata.
main.ts:10-23, src/bun_runtime.ts:24-29, and src/worker.ts:106-112 pass actual peer or authenticated edge metadata into the handler.
src/handler_test.ts:317-343, src/main_test.ts:57-68, and tests/bun_test.ts:75-239 cover forged direct headers and forged leading proxy-chain values.
